rule: One poison slot per target; a monster cannot poison its own family; some equipment and one skill block poison. Curse paralysis is a telegraphed three-phase state: a windup (visible tint, server message), then a timed lock, then a cure; players get a long windup, monsters none; the curse is refused while earth bind, ice lance, freezing blizzard or freezing breath is active. Short random stuns and bleeds draw one weighted number from a fixed range and map it to a few discrete durations. Bleed is 5 damage per second and never brings HP below one. Skill-effect timers tick once per second and round the length down to whole seconds. A re-application replaces a timer only if it is longer, and a zero-time flag stays until killed. Stat debuffs add directly to stats with no categories or caps.
keep: One status slot per target for poison, with a family rule so a pack cannot poison itself
A telegraphed windup (visible tint and server message) before a hard lock
